facts.business: Global Capital Markets Limited is a listed company engaged in financial services including loans, advances, and investments.

auditor.name: Maheshwari & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: 1. Some dormant bank accounts (held with Kotak Mahindra Bank, and ICICI Bank) totalling to 0.12 lakhs, are reflected in the books of accounts. 2. Interest income is not recognized on outstanding advances given to various parties amounting to Rs. 563.24 lakhs and no such documents are provided before us to enable to Crystallize the interest rate on the advances hence in the absence of sufficient information, we are unable to calculate the interest income to be recognized on such advances. It was explained that necessary discussions are under process to recover the said advances. We have solely relied on management's representation for the aforementioned treatments and disclosures. 3. Interest income is not recognized on outstanding loans given to various parties amounting to Rs. 409.52 lakhs and no such documents are provided before us to enable to Crystallize the interest rate on the loans hence in the absence of sufficient information, we are unable to calculate the interest income to be recognized on such loans. It was explained that necessary discussions are under process to recover the said loans and accordingly the impact will be taken care. We have solely relied on management's representation for the aforementioned treatments and disclosures. 4. During the year ended 31 March 2026, the Company has, for the first time, recognised and measured Expected Credit Loss (ECL) in respect of its financial assets, including receivables under dispute, in accordance with the requirements of Ind AS 109 – Financial Instruments. The Company has recognised the ECL provision based on the assessment of credit risk and expected recoverability of the underlying financial assets as at 31 March 2026. 5. Balance in the account of Loan & Advances are subject to confirmation/reconciliation and subsequent adjustment, if any required. The management does not expect any material adjustments in respect of the same affecting the Financial Statement on such reconciliation /adjustment.

key_risks: Non-recognition of interest income on outstanding advances of Rs. 563.24 lakhs due to lack of documentation
Non-recognition of interest income on outstanding loans of Rs. 409.52 lakhs due to lack of documentation
First-time recognition of Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provision under Ind AS 109
Loan & Advances balances subject to confirmation/reconciliation
Dormant bank accounts totalling 0.12 lakhs reflected in books
